overview_description.description:
PRISM56 is an investment workflow layer for venture teams. It turns decks, notes, and company data into structured scorecards, risk registers, missing-information lists, diligence questions, and memo-ready investment analysis. The platform helps investors run faster, more consistent diligence across deal flow, joint ventures, and private-market opportunities.

PRISM56 is a Fikra Ventures portfolio company.
